known_outcome: Council answer (leakage): the IBC defines an exterior wall as sloped 60 degrees or more from horizontal; through WSEC R201.3 that definition applies, so a surface steeper than 60 degrees is a wall assembly and a surface below 60 degrees is a roof/ceiling assembly.
review_focus: which assembly category applies to non-standard building surfaces
borrowing definitions from other codes (WSEC R201.3)
the 60-degree slope threshold as the deciding test
what the applicant must still show for each assembly class
